subject: general
question:
Which cell organelle is defined as the small round organelle that undergoes oxidation reaction to produce hydrogen

peroxide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peroxisomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Peroxisomes - **

 
 
• Peroxisomes are small, membrane-bound organelles that contain enzymes involved in various metabolic reactions, including the oxidation of fatty acids and amino acids.
 
• These organelles play a crucial role in detoxifying harmful substances and in lipid metabolism.
 
• They produce hydrogen peroxide as a byproduct of these reactions, which is then broken down by the enzyme catalase.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Centrosome

 
 
• Centrosome was discovered by T. Boberi in 1888.
 
• In almost all types of colonocytes except the nerve cell, a star-like structure is visible in the cytoplasm near the nucleus, which is called the centrosome.
 
• It helps in cell division,
 
• Forms cilia and flagellum and makes the tail of spermatozoa.
 
 

 
• **Vacuole**

 
 
• Vacuole__ is surrounded by the __tonoplast__, a type of cytoplasmic membrane that can stretch and fills itself with a solution known as cell sap
 
• Vacuoles are found mainly in plant cells and are filled with water, containing inorganic and organic molecules.
 
 

 
• **Nucleus**

 
 
• The nucleus is a pivotal organelle responsible to regulate almost all forms of cellular activities.
 
• Mostly, every type of cell that exists is categorized on the basis of the absence or presence of the nucleus within its cell (categorized either as a prokaryotic or eukaryotic cell.)
